scope: Finite mathematical sufficient-condition map for the reconstruction. AND gates require every child. At an OR gate each listed alternative is a sufficient route, with its full hypotheses. This is neither an exhaustive Lean dependency graph nor a necessity/minimality claim.
increment_integration: v0.23: HP1–HP4 close the literal polynomial highest-weight/fixed-line/tensor theorem; HP5–HP6 preserve original interfaces. VW1–VW4 and WB1–WB8 close complete downstream implications with their deep supplier contracts retained. DA1–DA2 close the finite-threshold and global-link assembly. Independent text reviews are indexed in integration_delta.json.
